facts.fact: Angola's Ministry of Finance says audits cross-checked data from the newly launched civil service human resources system SINGERH against state payrolls, flagging more than 31,000 suspected ghost workers.

systems.country_label: Sistema Integrado de Gestao de Recursos Humanos da Funcao Publica (SINGERH)

AGO.note: The Finance Minister says flagged staff hold active NIF in the tax system, but the document does not say the register is computerised, shared or tied to the national ID.
